summary: Draganfly Inc., a Canadian foreign private issuer, furnished a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing a third-quarter 2026 shareholder update and earnings call scheduled for November 10, 2026, at 5:30 p.m. EST, with results to be released after market close that day. CEO Cameron Chell and CFO Paul Sun will lead the call. No transaction, stake, price, or board recommendation is disclosed. The filing is a routine earnings-call scheduling notice; there is no special-situation event, no deal terms, and no arbitrage angle.
